title: How Do Hand Warmers Get Hot? #Shorts
description:
How do hand warmers get hot? They rust. Inside the pouch is super fine iron powder with salt, charcoal and a damp filler. Tear open the wrapper and air slips in through tiny holes in the pouch, the oxygen turns the iron into rust, and rusting gives off heat. Salt makes it rust fast, charcoal spreads the heat, and it stays toasty up to about 135 degrees for 7 to 24 hours. Shake it to let more air in. Seal it in an airtight zip bag and it pauses. Keep used ones away from kids and pets.
